Winter rains have deepened the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, while the conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Saudi Arabia dismissed its coalition commander as the anti-Houthi forces pulled back from the strait and other key areas, and the Yemeni parliament designated the Houthis as terrorists, prompting concerns of a resurgence by southern separatists. item.description:
The Sudanese Armed Forces have seized Al-Khuwai and five other sites in West Kordofan and are pushing toward Al-Nahud while reinforcing the Blue Nile front, increasing pressure on the Rapid Support Forces. The RSF continues to conduct drone strikes on civilian populations and power stations, causing darkness and civilian casualties, including children. A Rapid Support Forces field commander defected to the SAF and a former RSF adviser was released in Chad, while a former Sudanese information minister was attacked in Uganda. A former Sudanese official wanted by the ICC was arrested, confirming U.S. involvement. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
